A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable 27-page versions of the same work, including Appendices A–D. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish that only the first-page arXiv version/date stamp differs.

before.justification: v2 reports original training and evaluation results on TLDR summarization, No Robots instruction following, and GSM8k mathematical reasoning, including further experiments in the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results, including synchronous/asynchronous comparisons in Tables 1–2 and additional evaluations in Appendices A–C.

M1.justification: The asynchronous generation/training procedure, Section 4 compute optimizations, Proximal RLOO formulation in Appendix B, and Algorithm 1 are identical.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same TLDR, No Robots, and GSM8k datasets and tasks. No training or evaluation scenario is added, removed, or revised in the appendices.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical in corresponding experiments, including PPO, RLOO, Online DPO, Best-of-2, and the Appendix B comparison with CoPG-style RLOO.

E3.justification: Sections 3–5 and Appendix A report identical data splits, metrics, model scales, episode budgets, generation settings, and GPU allocations.

E4.justification: The off-policy robustness sweeps, model-scaling analyses, multiple-update and sampling studies, and appendix runtime and robustness analyses are unchanged.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is identical in the text, tables, and plots. v3 adds no run/seed information or uncertainty-estimation procedures.

E6.justification: All numerical entries and plotted results match. Examples include the 57.20% No Robots win rates for both Online DPO variants in Table 1 and GSM8k pass@1 of 52.2% synchronous versus 52.6% asynchronous in Table 2.

T1.justification: The RLHF/DPO objectives in Section 2 and the importance-sampling and clipping derivation for Proximal RLOO in Appendix B are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's six contributions, and conclusion are identical, retaining the same efficiency, off-policy robustness, and scalability claims.

C2.justification: Interpretations of policy-size robustness and speed/KL trade-offs are unchanged. Both retain the same qualifications about optimized synchronous libraries and asynchronous communication overhead.

D1.justification: Appendix A's implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware, preprocessing, and runtime information are identical. The reproducibility statement and code, checkpoint, and dataset access information also match.

R1.justification: The cited works, bibliography, and positioning relative to prior RLHF and distributed-training research are identical, including Section 6 and Appendix C.

P1.justification: Only the first-page arXiv stamp changes from v2 dated 15 Mar 2025 to v3 dated 26 Apr 2025. Manuscript prose, headings, and organization are otherwise identical.

P2.justification: All 14 figures, 11 tables, captions, placements, and page layouts match. The marginal version/date text update does not revise the layout.

improvement.justification: The only visible change is the arXiv version/date stamp. Methods, results, explanations, limitations, and appendix material are otherwise identical, establishing no meaningful net change in paper quality.
